Metrics.Name: graph2otel.api.unexpected
Metrics.Description: Microsoft API responses that did not match what this collector was built against, by kind. Non-zero means an assumption needs re-checking; see the WARN log for the offending value.

Metrics.Name: intune.noncompliant_settings.count
Metrics.Description: Counts of noncompliant device×setting rows from the Intune NoncompliantDevicesAndSettings export report, bucketed by OS and decoded setting status; per-setting detail is on the intune.noncompliant_setting log twin.
